_source: this project's contracts (P256Validator, P256RecoveryValidator, P256Signer, AgentPolicy, SafeNonceAssert, DemoCounter) as runtime code built from this repository's sources, and WhitelistPaymaster (constructor: EntryPoint, owner) and MockUSDC (contracts/test/AgentPermission.t.sol) as creation code: scripts/test-fixtures.py --write rewrites them from the build, and CI fails when one is behind it; AgentPolicy's immutable, the SafeNonceAssert address, is written into its runtime code as the address given here. The addresses are Base Sepolia's, kept as names for the places. Third-party code is runtime bytecode read from Base Sepolia and not rebuilt: EntryPoint v0.7 and its SenderCreator, Kernel v3.3 and its factory, ZeroDev's FactoryStaker (read on 2026-11-24; its owner, approval of Kernel's factory and stake the harness sets as they are on the chain: issue #102), Solady's P-256 verifier, Safe v1.3.0 (L2 singleton, proxy factory, MultiSendCallOnly) for the Safe-guarded path. All are installed with anvil_setCode; none has constructor-set storage but the FactoryStaker. Solady's CANARY is deliberately absent: its code tells P256 that the RIP-7212 precompile exists, which a plain anvil lacks, so P256 must fall back to the VERIFIER
